# Linkup

> The production-grade Web Search API for AI. Used by McKinsey, SNCF, Cohere, Legora, Polymarket, and Artisan AI. #1 on OpenAI's SimpleQA.

Linkup is a web search API that gives AI applications and agents real-time, grounded access to the web through a single API call, or deployed inside your own cloud for enterprise needs. Prefer the Documentation links below (markdown) for API usage; use Key pages for product, pricing, and proof.

## Key pages
- [Linkup](https://www.linkup.so/): Product overview and live API playground.
- [Enterprise](https://www.linkup.so/product/enterprise): Private and on-prem deployments for enterprise AI systems.
- [Pricing](https://www.linkup.so/pricing): Pay-as-you-go, transparent pricing for the search API.
- [Blog](https://www.linkup.so/blog): Guides, benchmarks, and engineering notes on web search for AI.
- [Benchmarks](https://www.linkup.so/benchmarks): SimpleQA, SealQA-0, GTM, Legal, and Finance benchmark results.
- [Case Studies](https://www.linkup.so/case-studies): How customers build with Linkup APIs.
- [Startups](https://www.linkup.so/startups): Free API credits for startups building with real-time web search.
- [About](https://www.linkup.so/about): The team and mission behind Linkup.
- [Careers](https://www.linkup.so/careers): Open roles at Linkup.
- [Contact](https://www.linkup.so/contact): Talk to the team and start building.

## Documentation
- [Full documentation index](https://docs.linkup.so/llms.txt): Complete llms.txt for API reference, tutorials, SDKs, and integrations.
- [Introduction](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/documentation/get-started/introduction.md): What the Linkup API is and when to use it.
- [Quickstart](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/documentation/get-started/quickstart.md): Integrate with Linkup in about five minutes.
- [For AI agents](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/documentation/get-started/for-agents.md): Knowledge pack for agents: which API to call and how to write queries.
- [/search](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/documentation/endpoints/search/overview.md): Agentic web search with depths and sourced, structured, or answer output.
- [/fetch](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/documentation/endpoints/fetch/overview.md): Turn any public URL (HTML or PDF) into clean, LLM-ready markdown or JSON.
- [/research](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/documentation/endpoints/research/overview.md): Multi-step research agent that produces sourced answers and reports.
- [/tasks](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/documentation/endpoints/tasks/overview.md): Asynchronous batch wrapper around /search, /fetch, and /research.
- [Authentication](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/documentation/platform/authentication.md): API keys and how to authenticate requests.
- [Python SDK](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/sdk/python/python.md): Use Linkup natively from Python.
- [JavaScript SDK](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/sdk/js/js.md): Use Linkup natively from JavaScript and TypeScript.
- [MCP server](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/integrations/mcp/mcp.md): Use Linkup from MCP clients such as Cursor and Claude.
- [Security & privacy](https://docs.linkup.so/pages/security-and-privacy/overview.md): Certifications, data processing model, and security controls.

Every extra hop adds dollars, seconds, and operational headache. What if you could collapse that entire chain into a single endpoint?
